messages:
maria_cs: FYI customer acme-corp (Private VPC) reports dashboard heatmaps and usage charts for their tenant are blank since we rolled the auth-proxy last night. They see live inference but no metrics in Console.

kevin_support: They opened a ticket - attach logs and tenant id  tenant_acme_42. Says graphs showed data up to 01:03 UTC then nothing.

maria_cs: Repro steps from customer: 1) send request to hosted endpoint via company gateway 2) replies succeed 3) console shows 0 tokens, heatmap empty. They confirmed no retention policy changes.

dan_eng: Can you share an example request/headers (sanitized)? suspect header strip.

maria_cs: Here's a sanitized curl: 
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer *****" -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: tenant_acme_42" https://private-api.acme.example.com/v1/generate
Response 200, payload ok. But our ingestion shows no tenant_id.

oliver_sre: metrics-bot: Did ingestion receive any events for tenant_acme_42 after 1978451000?

metrics-bot: @oliver_sre automated check: No events tagged with tenant_acme_42 in the last 24h. Global ingestion shows traffic for that gateway IP but missing tenant header.

dan_eng: That points to header rewrite at the ingress/gateway. ingress-bot, did the proxy rewrite rule for x-redwood-tenant go live in the swap?

ingress-bot: Deploy 2026-03-17T01:00Z: auth-proxy v2.4.1 rolled to acme gateway cluster. Change log: canonicalize incoming header names and drop unknown custom headers unless whitelisted.

kevin_support: Customer says they didn't change anything. Could our whitelist accidentally exclude X-Redwood-Tenant (case mismatch or prefix)?

dan_eng: Likely. Old proxy preserved the header regardless of case; new one normalizes to lower-case and only passes headers matching acl: [authorization, content-type, cookie, x-forwarded-for, x-request-id]. X-Redwood-Tenant not on list.

oliver_sre: Quick repro on staging: set gateway rule to drop tenant header -> Console shows 204 from metrics ingest for those events (we accept telemetry but map to unknown tenant => dropped). Logs: 
[ingest] WARN missing tenant header, dropping event, source_ip=10.4.8.22

maria_cs: Customer still has live requests (we can see inference logs) but console shows 0. Customer is escalating to their security team because they think metrics missing implies data loss.

dan_eng: Proposed immediate mitigation: update proxy whitelist to forward X-Redwood-Tenant (case-insensitive). I'll push a hotfix to acme gateway and restart proxy (no downtime, rolling).

oliver_sre: Also add logging to detect header normalization issues and a small alert if >95% of requests from a known gateway lack tenant header.

maria_cs: Please coordinate with customer before change and let them know we'll try a hotfix.

kevin_support: Noted - pinging customer now and offering temporary workaround (set tenant as query param ?tenant=tenant_acme_42) while we patch. They prefer patch.

ingress-bot: Rolling update scheduled: auth-proxy v2.4.1 -> v2.4.1-hotfix at 1978459800 on acme cluster (rolling).

metrics-bot: After rollout: ingestion shows events tagged tenant_acme_42 starting at 1978460100. Console data pipeline caught up; heatmaps show data from 01:03 onward.

dan_eng: Confirmed: server logs show header present again, and we map tenant properly. Will open a follow-up RFC to avoid whitelist regressions.

maria_cs: Customer confirmed charts repopulated, very relieved. They want RCA and SLA credit ask - routing to account team. :thumbsup:

oliver_sre: RCA summary for ticket: auth-proxy normalization removed custom header from allowed list during swap; telemetry ingestion drops events with missing tenant; hotfix re-enabled header pass-through. Permanent fix: canonical whitelist update + automated e2e test and an alert.

kevin_support: Created support ticket #T-8132 with RCA notes and next steps. Closing thread after follow-ups with sales/account.

maria_cs: Thanks all. Leaving notes in casebook and adding to incident runbook under "private-vpc header mapping". :white_check_mark:
